（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.
#90
2/8/16
August 2nd 1916.
FILED

Sir,

It is reported that Deputy Military Governor Lu is
not satisfied with the present government. Representatives
of General Chang Hsun are said to be in Woosung at present
conferring with him regarding the formation of a military
party which will be in opposition to the Government.

Sixty men returned from Sungkiang to Loongwha on 1st
instant bringing 30 ponies, 6 field guns and 8 boxes
of ammunition with them.

One tenth of the Arsenal workmen are dismissed
at the end of each month. It is reported that the
workmen have threatened to go on strike if the authorities
continue to comply with these instructions.

It is reported that some military officers are
using their influence to have Z... Kol. Liang, Chief of
Police, retained in his present post.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmmmmm
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
编号
（印章：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

上海工部局。
#90
2/8/16
1916年8月2日。
已归档

先生：

据报，陆军副总督卢对现政府不满。据说张勋将军的代表目前身在吴淞，正与其商谈组建一个反对政府的军事派系事宜。

本月1日，六十人从松江返回龙华，随行携带30匹小马、6门野战炮和8箱弹药。

兵工厂工人每月底有十分之一被解雇。据报，如果当局继续执行这些指令，工人们已威胁要举行罢工。

据报，一些军官正在利用其影响力，试图让警察局长梁……上校（原文不清）留任现职。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmmmmm
总探长。

警务处总监
